content.content:
Applies once to the dependent's recorded content, read against all three prerequisites in depends_on. Nothing runs at this layer: a reviewer applies the two criteria below to the recorded documents and reports the finding.

1. Applicability: the check applies only to a dependent that carries decision content. If the dependent's recorded content is the skeleton placeholder (`<placeholder>`), empty, or otherwise carries no commitment to licence, the criterion is not met — fail naming the dependent and the placeholder or missing element, and let no empty text pass as licence.

2. License, applied once per prerequisite in depends_on: no element of the dependent contradicts that prerequisite. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element and the prerequisite it departs from.

Which element is at issue is what the check discovers at check time; nothing is pre-named here, so rewriting the dependent without changing what it decides leaves the criterion intact.
content.rationale:
The dependent is one prose commitment — reading a record refuses a document that does not conform — and every one of its three prerequisites is read as words at the layer the check meets it on. zmmyomyp is inline prose (`text`), so that edge is natural-to-natural and takes that cell's gate check. rqtowtqn is an inline requirement sentence (`ears`), so it is structured; wrvsxwmq refs a schema, which the matrix counts as code. Natural-to-natural's licence sentence is the base every gate cell reuses, natural-to-structured repeats it verbatim, and the structured-to-natural and code-to-natural cells are listed in the matrix as `default` — the gate form plus a flag to extend the matrix — so all three edges take the same licence check, whichever of prose or EARS the dependent is written in (prose puts the two non-prose parents in the `default` cells; EARS puts zmmyomyp in natural-to-structured and leaves the other two in `default`). That flag is reported with this gate: those cells have no dedicated eval file yet, and the gate form is the matrix's stated fallback until one exists.

One evaluation carries the three edges because they are one answer read three ways. Nothing about the refusal is checkable without the document's form (wrvsxwmq), without the document being the one found at the handle-derived path (rqtowtqn), and without the checking being the validator rather than a hand-rolled inspection (zmmyomyp); a single licence pass reads the whole dependent against all three, so splitting would licence the same sentences three times. The criterion is applied once per prerequisite at check time, so a contradiction with any one of them is reported as that edge's finding.

Criterion 1 is the applicability the licence pass needs, and it is why this gate is not vacuous. A licence check over a skeleton's placeholder text finds no element to contradict, so it passes with nothing to pass on: a green over an unwritten decision, blind to the content being absent rather than sound. Criterion 1 fixes when the check may be applied at all — only to a recorded dependent carrying decision content — and fails, naming the placeholder, while the dependent is still a skeleton. It constrains nothing the decision may say: any content that commits to something satisfies it, so it survives a rewording of the dependent and adds no rule the prerequisites do not state.

What each prerequisite carries into the check. rqtowtqn fixes that a record is exactly one JSON document at `.deccy/work/<handle>.json`, its filename the record's handle, its content the whole record, and the stored records enumerated only by scanning that directory; a dependent that read a record from anything but the document its filename names, or that looked it up through an index or second layout, would contradict it. wrvsxwmq fixes the document's form as `schemas/work.json`: the closed field set, the `open`/`landed` enum, the one-string references, the nested workspace and the unfixed base values, as shape and not meaning; a dependent that refused a document the schema admits, or admitted one it refuses, would contradict it. zmmyomyp fixes how documents are checked — the `jsonschema` crate compiling the draft 2020-12 schema in-process, never hand-rolled validation; a dependent whose refusal was made by hand-written field inspection would contradict it.

Not fixed and not demanded here: how a refusal is reported, what the reading verb prints, which exit status it uses, whether a missing file counts as a refusal, and how the schema is located at run time. Each is a separate commitment, and the licence check presupposes no decision beyond the three recorded prerequisites. A prose child is a commitment in words, so this gate is non-violation and never demands behaviour; it names no function, path, verb or message that the decision does not itself state.
